description: Bug report from a user of the packaging library: a float read by mistake from a config file was passed to packaging.version.Version (Version(2.5)), and it raised a bare TypeError instead of packaging's InvalidVersion, so code that catches InvalidVersion crashed. Invalid input must always raise InvalidVersion. Find the problem and fix it. Change src/packaging/version.py only.
environment: Python >= 3.13 stdlib; base tree = pypa/packaging 9a11fba (src, tests, licenses, pyproject, README, .gitignore), no repository history; the project's own test suite needs pytest, which is not installed
visible_checks: python -c "from src.packaging.version import Version; print(Version('1.0rc1'))" (from the workspace root; pytest is not available)
provenance: real fix: pypa/packaging commit d3e7f5d (fix(version): reject non-string versions consistently, #1319, 2026-07-08), base = its parent 9a11fba; reference/good.patch is that commit's src diff; symptom-only description naming a float; hidden cases authored for agent-benchmark (2026-10-11): other non-string inputs, one of which (a list) fails through a different exception at the base, plus string guards; other reference patches built by build_task.py. Public repository: contamination possible
